Class Layout

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.layout.Layout
public final class Layout extends Object
A layout defines how to split a rectangular area into smaller areas based on constraints.

The layout uses a Cassowary constraint solver to compute sizes based on the provided constraints, then positions the resulting rectangles according to the Flex mode.

Example usage: 

Layout layout = Layout.horizontal()
    .constraints(
        Constraint.length(20),
        Constraint.fill(),
        Constraint.percentage(30))
    .spacing(1)
    .flex(Flex.CENTER);

List<Rect> areas = layout.split(new Rect(0, 0, 100, 50));
